data.one_liner: Draw standard second and third order Bezier curves to clip widgets easily.
data.what_it_does: Provides clipper widgets and data sections to easily draw second and third order Bezier curves for widget clipping or custom paths without complex manual point calculations.
use_when: You need to clip widgets with standard Bezier curves (e.g. waves, arches).
You want to avoid complex manual point and offset calculations for path clipping.
avoid_when: You require complex chart rendering or non-bezier graphic pipelines.
You need animations along the bezier paths.
strengths: Simplifies drawing second and third order Bezier curves for clipping.
Reduces boilerplate code compared to writing native CustomClipper paths from scratch.
Supports multiple curve sections and smooth configurations.
weaknesses: Limited to Bezier curve clipping and paths.
Documentation outside the README is minimal.
